title: Vibecoding + Real Artists
author: eval_ent
selftext: I’ve been working on my game Glyph Spellcraft since Agentic AI was made natively available within Xcode back in February. Claude was used for code, ElevenLabs was used for all sound effects and music, but all pixel art and animations were real freelance artists I found on Fiverr. AMA!

comments.author: Novel-Common9013
comments.body: It won't matter with real artists or AI Artists in the future. AI Art is the top of the art.

replies.author: eval_ent
replies.body: But where are people generating good pixel art? I tried PixelLab many times and was not satisfied with the results.

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: You need to fine-tune it. There should be option pixel density of image model.

replies.author: eval_ent
replies.body: The sprites are ok but the animations are what I didn’t like

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: Use different interpolation, cubic, ease in, ease out and framing is quite important for pixel things

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/olfknr64vsgh1.png?width=348&format=png&auto=webp&s=159ec39e2724261022b4837870a6d47b34322f5a

Those are generated pixel coordinates for rasterization (also unwrapping of cube but different in this case)

If you do not interpolate pixels in different cases them that would be look bad for frames, generally you target 30FPS.  
  
Use different keyframing curve techniques like quadratic interpolation if heavy attack will be processed.

I do not if you unvoting me but someone is always unvoting me

replies.author: RickRelentless
replies.body: Tell me you never made an actual game without telling me you never made an actual game

replies.author: Novel-Common9013
replies.body: What? I made real games and XR apps too.

replies.author: RickRelentless
replies.body: Okay, what I meant by that statement is: if your trying to create anything that isn’t completely derivative then it is so much easier to communicate your ideas to an actual (good) human artist and get them to consistently fill-in-the-gaps in the information you provide with correct decisions, than it is to do so with AI. If you’ve worked in dev teams on larger projects with (relatively) unique art-styles this becomes obvious quickly.

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: Would it matter if they were? Sound and Code are all AI already. Unless we're establishing pixel artists as a protected class of people over sound designers and programmers, there isn't really a moral high ground and it's more about whether fiverr gets you the results you want at the quality you want compared to just doing it yourself through whatever other means.
